sections.label: NYP sets up NYPi
sections.summary: In April 2007, NYP set up Nanyang Polytechnic International Pte Ltd (NYPi) to handle these activities.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: In April 2007, NYP set up Nanyang Polytechnic International Pte Ltd (NYPi) to handle these activities.

sections.label: NYPi is NYP subsidiary
sections.summary: NYPi is a fully-owned subsidiary of NYP and is not a third party vendor.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: First, NYPi is a fully-owned subsidiary of NYP and, hence, it is not a third party vendor.

sections.label: NYPi profits, directors, audit observations
sections.summary: NYPi profits belong to NYP, its board directors receive no fees, and AGO audit observations do not affect remuneration or benefits.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Profits made by NYPi, if any, ultimately belong to the parent, which is NYP.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Second, the NYPi's board directors do not receive any directors' fees.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The audit observations of the Auditor-General's Office (AGO) for the Financial Year (FY) 2015/2016 report have no bearing on the remuneration or benefits of NYPi's board directors and staff, and there is no question of any personal gain involved.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The mistake NYP has made was to continue treating NYPi as if it was a department or a division of NYP when it is no longer the case.

sections.label: NYP governance framework actions
sections.summary: NYP has taken immediate actions to put in place a proper governance framework for its transactions with NYPi.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: NYP has taken immediate actions to put in place a proper governance framework to handle its transactions with NYPi.

sections.label: Corporate governance lapse, no fraud
sections.summary: It is a corporate governance and process lapse, with no fraud involved and no disciplinary action warranted.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As a result, it is a corporate governance and process lapse.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: So, there is no fraud involved and, therefore, no disciplinary action ought to be taken in this aspect.
